review_evidence: README identifies the repository as the supporting library and editable examples for the Logic and Mechanized Reasoning course/textbook.
The 47 Lean files cover propositional and first-order logic, SAT/SMT/resolution interfaces and proof-assistant examples; proposition-bearing examples include formal proofs and induction developments.
This is directly relevant logic/formal-methods material, and tutorial status is not a lossless reason for exclusion under the filtering contract.
summary: Reviewed LAMR; retain its logic/mechanized-reasoning library and formal textbook examples.
